verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָוִ֥ד שִֽׁיר׃ לְךָ֤ דֻֽמִיָּ֬ה תְהִלָּ֓ה אֱלֹ֘הִ֥ים בְּצִיּ֑וֹן וּ֝לְךָ֗ יְשֻׁלַּם־ נֶֽדֶר׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ šîr lə·ḵā ḏu·mî·yāh ṯə·hil·lāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·ṣî·yō·wn ū·lə·ḵā yə·šul·lam- ne·ḏer
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David A song Praise awaits You O God in Zion to You our vows will be fulfilled
verses.literalPt: A TI, ó Deus, espera o louvor em Sião, e a ti se pagará o voto.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥עַ תְּפִלָּ֑ה עָ֝דֶ֗יךָ כָּל־ בָּשָׂ֥ר יָבֹֽאוּ׃
verses.literal: O You who listen to prayer all people will come to You
verses.literalPt: Ó tu que ouves as orações, a ti virá toda a carne.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עֲ֭וֺנֹת גָּ֣בְרוּ מֶ֑נִּי פְּ֝שָׁעֵ֗ינוּ אַתָּ֥ה תְכַפְּרֵֽם׃
verses.literal: When iniquities . . . prevail against me You atone for our transgressions
verses.literalPt: Prevalecem as iniqüidades contra mim; porém tu limpas as nossas transgressões.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י׀ תִּֽבְחַ֣ר וּתְקָרֵב֮ יִשְׁכֹּ֪ן חֲצֵ֫רֶ֥יךָ נִ֭שְׂבְּעָה בְּט֣וּב בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ הֵיכָלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê tiḇ·ḥar ū·ṯə·qā·rêḇ yiš·kōn ḥă·ṣê·re·ḵā niś·bə·‘āh bə·ṭūḇ bê·ṯe·ḵā qə·ḏōš hê·ḵā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts We are filled with the goodness of Your house the holiness of Your temple
verses.literalPt: Bem-aventurado aquele a quem tu escolhes, e fazes chegar a ti, para que habite em teus átrios; nós seremos fartos da bondade da tua casa e do teu santo templo.

verses.original: נ֤וֹרָא֨וֹת׀ בְּצֶ֣דֶק תַּ֭עֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ מִבְטָ֥ח כָּל־ קַצְוֵי־ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וְיָ֣ם רְחֹקִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ bə·ṣe·ḏeq ta·‘ă·nê·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê yiš·‘ê·nū miḇ·ṭāḥ kāl- qaṣ·wê- ’e·reṣ wə·yām rə·ḥō·qîm
verses.literal: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us O God of our salvation the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas
verses.literalPt: Com coisas tremendas em justiça nos responderás, ó Deus da nossa salvação; tu és a esperança de todas as extremidades da terra, e daqueles que estão longe sobre o mar.

verses.literal: You formed the mountains by Your power having girded Yourself with might
verses.literalPt: O que pela sua força consolida os montes, cingido de fortaleza;

verses.original: מַשְׁבִּ֤יחַ׀ שְׁא֣וֹן יַ֭מִּים שְׁא֥וֹן גַּלֵּיהֶ֗ם וַהֲמ֥וֹן לְאֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: maš·bî·aḥ šə·’ō·wn yam·mîm šə·’ō·wn gal·lê·hem wa·hă·mō·wn lə·’um·mîm
verses.literal: You stilled the roaring of the seas the pounding of their waves and the tumult of the nations
verses.literalPt: O que aplaca o ruído dos mares, o ruído das suas ondas, e o tumulto dos povos.

verses.original: וַיִּ֤ירְא֨וּ׀ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י קְ֭צָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶ֑יךָ מ֤וֹצָֽאֵי־ בֹ֖קֶר וָעֶ֣רֶב תַּרְנִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rə·’ū yō·šə·ḇê qə·ṣā·wōṯ mê·’ō·w·ṯō·ṯe·ḵā mō·w·ṣā·’ê- ḇō·qer wā·‘e·reḇ tar·nîn
verses.literal: Those who live far away fear Your wonders You make the dawn . . . and sunset shout for joy
verses.literalPt: E os que habitam nos fins da terra temem os teus sinais; tu fazes alegres as saídas da manhã e da tarde.

verses.original: פָּקַ֥דְתָּ הָאָ֨רֶץ׀ וַתְּשֹׁ֪קְקֶ֡הָ רַבַּ֬ת תַּעְשְׁרֶ֗נָּה פֶּ֣לֶג אֱ֭לֹהִים מָ֣לֵא מָ֑יִם תָּכִ֥ין דְּ֝גָנָ֗ם כִּי־ כֵ֥ן תְּכִינֶֽהָ׃
verses.transliteration: pā·qaḏ·tā hā·’ā·reṣ wat·tə·šō·qə·qe·hā rab·baṯ ta‘·šə·ren·nāh pe·leḡ ’ĕ·lō·hîm mā·lê mā·yim tā·ḵîn də·ḡā·nām kî- ḵên tə·ḵî·ne·hā
verses.literal: You attend to the earth and water it with abundance You enrich it The streams of God are full of water for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth
verses.literalPt: Tu visitas a terra, e a refrescas; tu a enriqueces grandemente com o rio de Deus, que está cheio de água; tu lhe preparas o trigo, quando assim a tens preparada.

verses.original: תְּלָמֶ֣יהָ רַ֭וֵּה נַחֵ֣ת גְּדוּדֶ֑יהָ בִּרְבִיבִ֥ים תְּ֝מֹגְגֶ֗נָּה צִמְחָ֥הּ תְּבָרֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tə·lā·me·hā raw·wêh na·ḥêṯ gə·ḏū·ḏe·hā bir·ḇî·ḇîm tə·mō·ḡə·ḡen·nāh ṣim·ḥāh tə·ḇā·rêḵ
verses.literal: You soak its furrows and level its ridges You soften it with showers and bless its growth
verses.literalPt: Enches de água os seus sulcos; tu lhe aplanas as leivas; tu a amoleces com a muita chuva; abençoas as suas novidades.

verses.original: עִ֭טַּרְתָּ שְׁנַ֣ת טוֹבָתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מַעְגָּלֶ֗יךָ יִרְעֲפ֥וּן דָּֽשֶׁן׃
verses.literal: You crown the year with Your bounty and Your paths overflow with plenty
verses.literalPt: Coroas o ano com a tua bondade, e as tuas veredas destilam gordura.

verses.original: יִ֭רְעֲפוּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר וְ֝גִ֗יל גְּבָע֥וֹת תַּחְגֹּֽרְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: yir·‘ă·p̄ū nə·’ō·wṯ miḏ·bār wə·ḡîl gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ taḥ·gō·rə·nāh
verses.literal: The pastures of the wilderness overflow the hills are robed with joy
verses.literalPt: Destilam sobre os pastos do deserto, e os outeiros os cingem de alegria.

verses.original: לָבְשׁ֬וּ כָרִ֨ים׀ הַצֹּ֗אן וַעֲמָקִ֥ים יַֽעַטְפוּ־ בָ֑ר יִ֝תְרוֹעֲע֗וּ אַף־ יָשִֽׁירוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḇə·šū ḵā·rîm haṣ·ṣōn wa·‘ă·mā·qîm ya·‘aṭ·p̄ū- ḇār yiṯ·rō·w·‘ă·‘ū ’ap̄- yā·šî·rū
verses.literal: The pastures are clothed with flocks and the valleys are decked with grain They shout in triumph indeed they sing
verses.literalPt: Os campos se vestem de rebanhos, e os vales se cobrem de trigo; eles se regozijam e cantam.
